infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Arrively shares your location with the customer you're driving to, so they know when you'll arrive.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Arrively keeps sharing your location while you're on a route, even when the app is in the background, so customers see an accurate ETA and stops are marked when you arrive and leave. Sharing stops when you end your shift.
